sentences.en: Climate change threatens to exacerbate existing social and economic inequalities.
sentences.zh: 气候变化有可能加剧现有的社会和经济不平等。

sentences.en: The Nationalist movements in both countries have been exacerbating the problem.
sentences.zh: 两国的民族主义运动一直在使问题恶化。

sentences.en: Hot and blustery conditions will exacerbate the risk of fire tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 炎热多风的条件将使明天发生火灾的风险进一步增加。
